title: Jio Platforms IPO Details
intro:
Jio Platforms IPO is a book build issue of ₹30,213.00 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 27.00 crore shares of ₹30,213.00 crore.

Jio Platforms IPO opens for subscription on Oct 21, 2026 and closes on Oct 23, 2026. The allotment for the Jio Platforms IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 26, 2026. Jio Platforms IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 28, 2026.

Jio Platforms IPO is set issue price band at ₹1,065 to ₹1,119 per share. The lot size for an application is 12 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹13,428 (12 shares) (based on upper price).

Kotak Mahindra Capital Co.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Jio Platforms IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated on November 15, 2019, Jio Platforms Limited is a technology company focused on digital connectivity, digital services and technology-led solutions in India. The Company has developed proprietary digital technology and pan-India connectivity infrastructure to support the delivery of digital services to consumers and businesses. Its subsidiary, Reliance Jio Infocomm Limited, served 533.3 million customers as of June 30, 2026.The Company operates through an integrated technology platform encompassing digital connectivity, consumer applications, enterprise solutions, cloud services, Internet of Things (IoT) and artificial intelligence (AI). Its consumer offerings include mobile and fixed broadband, digital entertainment, cloud storage, virtual PC services and smart home solutions. For businesses, it provides enterprise connectivity, cloud and security solutions, managed services, IoT applications and AI-based solutions. The Company’s proprietary technology capabilities span network infrastructure, device engineering, software, operating systems and digital applications.

The Company’s infrastructure includes pan-India 4G and 5G connectivity, fibre connectivity across more than 1,200 facilities and over 100 edge nodes within its networks as of June 30, 2026. Its wireless broadband network covered more than 99% of India’s population. The Company and its subsidiaries had filed 7,220 patent applications, of which 1,043 had been granted, as of June 30, 2026. Its technology initiatives include an indigenous 5G technology stack, proprietary AI platform JioBrain and fixed wireless access technology. The Company also leverages a nationwide distribution network and partnerships to expand access to digital services.

As of June 30, 2026, the Company had 27,932 full-time employees and engaged 63,795 personnel on a contract basis. Its workforce includes teams across digital products and technology development, business operations, sales and distribution, customer service, network operations, and corporate functions.
strengths: Leadership in digital connectivity and services across India.
Diversified portfolio of consumer and enterprise digital services.
Large and highly engaged customer base with nationwide reach.
Nationwide digital distribution network and strategic group synergies.
Proven ability to scale operations and deploy new technologies rapidly.
Extensive pan-India network infrastructure with 4G and 5G capabilities.
Proprietary technology platform with in-house engineering and full-stack capabilities.
Strong innovation capabilities supported by patents, AI and technology development.

faqs.question: How to apply in Jio Platforms IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Jio Platforms IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Jio Platforms IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Jio Platforms IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Jio Platforms IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: The Jio Platforms IPO opens on Wed, Oct 21, 2026 and closes on Fri, Oct 23, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Jio Platforms IPO?
faqs.answer: Jio Platforms IPO lot size is 12 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹13,428 .

faqs.question: How to apply for Jio Platforms IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Jio Platforms IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Jio Platforms IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Jio Platforms IPO will be done on Monday, October 26, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Tue, Oct 27, 2026 . Check the Jio Platforms IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Jio Platforms IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Jio Platforms IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Wed, Oct 28, 2026 .
